heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly to partly sunny south; partly to mostly cloudy north. Highs in the low to mid 50s far north and in the Champlain Valley, mid to upper 50s elsewhere north, and upper 50s to mid 60s in the south. North winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy early, then mainly clear. Lows from the upper 20s to mid 30s, except low to mid 20s in northern cold hollows. North winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly sunny. Valley highs in the low to mid 50s, some upper 40s far north. North winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph.
